'''Sparky''' was an huge [[exoboar]] owned by the [[Ravagers]], a pirate gang based on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Sparky had a large litter of young exoboars&mdash;[[Dinner (exoboar)|Dinner]], [[Duke (exoboar)|Duke]], [[Grappa (exoboar)|Grappa]], [[Jwizzix'Xthor]], [[Nerf (exoboar)|Nerf]], [[North (exoboar)|North]], [[Precious (exoboar)|Precious]], [[Scrapp]], [[Tank (exoboar)|Tank]], [[The Boss]], [[Voguz]], [[Deshy]] [[Little Pirate]], [[Spike (exoboar)|Spike]], [[Mu Na Ya]], and [[Tenebro]]&mdash;that guarded the gate to [[Coratanni Town]]. In [[3637 BBY]], the independent operatives hired by [[Ruugar]], the former leader of the Ravagers, to take out his traitorous [[Coratanni]], and Sparky was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the operatives along with her litter.
